en: A black-and-white photograph depicting a street parade or procession with people marching and carrying flags. The participants, both men and women, are dressed in early 20th-century European attire. In the background, there are horse-drawn carts and more pedestrians. The scene appears to take place on a cobblestone street. One of the carts in the background has readable text that says 'GREINER' and 'BISCHWILLER', possibly indicating a business or location.
